title: Timeline/export claim "sent" for failed/skipped send batches and the reminder ordinal overwrites the failure detail — the new evidence record is less faithful than the RC4.3 export it replaces
evidence:
let label = case first_kind(entries) {
    "invitation_sent" -> copy.refcheck_timeline_invitation
    "co_nudge" -> nudge_label(entries)
    "reminder_sent" -> reminder_label(first_or_empty(entries))
    other -> other
  }
  TimelineLine(label <> " — " <> channels, first_at(entries))
detail: Sweep stores every channel outcome — send.gleam:195 'ChannelOutcome(Email, Skipped, "no RESEND_API_KEY")', send.gleam:204 'Error(reason) -> ChannelOutcome(Email, Failed, reason)'. build_send_entries replaces reminder detail with the ordinal: 'let detail = case cycle_index { n if n >= 2 -> int.to_string(n - 1); _ -> attempt.detail }'. Client renders "Invitation sent — email + SMS" and "Reminder 2 sent" unconditionally: the export/timeline claims a send happened when it failed or was skipped, and the reason is dropped. The RC4.3 export this diff deletes rendered per-attempt outcome + detail ('attempt.at <> " - " <> attempt.channel <> " - " <> attempt.outcome'), so the evidence-grade record loses fidelity.
recommended_fix: Preserve outcome fidelity like the co-nudge: label failed/skipped invitation/reminder batches honestly (e.g. "Reminder 2 couldn't send — reason"), and keep the reason alongside the ordinal in the entry.
